description: Create, update or delete a monitor. A monitor checks each new Elfa event against a plain-words query, and searches the web for it every hour, and POSTs each match to webhookUrl, signed with Standard Webhooks. It reports only what appears after it is created, and runs unattended until deleted. A live monitor costs 2 credits for each started hour, the first hour on create, which is 1,440 credits for a 30-day month; update and delete are free, and a failed create is never charged. A key holds 20 live monitors. create returns the monitor with webhookSecret, which verifies its webhook signatures and never changes. update changes query, webhookUrl or both and keeps the id and secret; a monitor takes one change at a time, and an ended one cannot be changed. delete stops it, and no hour after the delete is charged. If create or update times out or answers 503, the change may still apply: read the monitors before retrying.

method.description: create starts a new monitor. update changes one. delete stops and removes one.

query.description: What should match, in plain words, 3 to 500 characters, such as "Binance announces it will delist a token". It is the whole condition, matched by meaning: search syntax and time ranges add nothing. Required for create.

webhookUrl.description: An https URL on a public host that receives each match. Private and reserved addresses are refused. Required for create.

name: monitors_write
